text:
```yaml
name: Pre‑commit autofix trigger for bot PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  checks: read
  statuses: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  precommit_autofix_trigger:
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' || endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]')
    uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger/.github/workflows/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger.yml@55d00aab
```
